criteria.rationale: The patient was 28 years old on the request date, meeting the minimum age of 12.
The PA request specifies chronic weight management, and the requested Wegovy order is for weight loss.
The August 5 note documents continued diet, exercise, and program visits; the May 13 dietitian note also documents ongoing dietary changes and walking. Both are within 180 days of the request.

The latest structured BMI is 29.95, below 30 but above 27. No qualifying weight-related comorbidity is documented to establish the BMI ≥27 pathway; absent documentation does not establish that none exists.
